title: Simple Blog with Image Upload
description: A minimalistic blog webpage that allows users to create blog posts with a title, description, and an image. The design is bright and visually appealing, with images prominently displayed in the center.

features.name: Create Blog Post
features.description: Allows users to create a blog post by entering a title, description, and uploading an image. The image will be displayed in the center of the post.

features.name: Upload Image
features.description: Enables users to upload an image to be included in their blog post. No restrictions on file size or format.

constraints: No user authentication or roles are required.
No specific technology stack or hosting requirements.
The design should have a bright but not monotonous background.
target_users: Individuals looking for a simple platform to create and share blog posts with images.
data_requirements: Each blog post should store a title, description, and an image.

user_clarifications.Do you have any specific preferences for: Bright but not monotonous background, with the image placed in the middle
